# names with count 3: "abcd" and "abcd" at 4 to 20, then a third length word 00000000 at 20, which would pass the limit (20) though the input holds it.

type names
breaks 5.4, point 3.1 and point 5
expect CapExceeded test.names
offset 20
extent none
requests test.names:slots3 test.label:4 test.label:4
input 00000003 00000004 61626364 00000004 61626364 00000000
